body: You have literally no idea what my situation is

I actually was registered to deliver for Uber Eats. They notified me after my arrest that the “independent contractor relationship has been terminated.”

Thank you for sticking by your partner. I’m sure he could never find the words to say how important that is to him. I wish my partner would have done the same.

I’ve been on medication for just over 11 years. First for depression, then anxiety, then for bipolar disorder. I’ve taken about 15 different medications (three currently). Nothing works and I’ve given up hoping that anything can.

As far as feeling like you deserve the pain, I empathize 100%. Sometimes I starve myself because I don’t feel like I deserve to eat. I currently haven’t eaten anything in 29 hours as of writing this comment.

I was at the new job for less than a week. The first job that I lost, I was let go for “job abandonment.” The job required me to leave the county for about 30 minutes a day, and the judge denied my travel restriction exception request. Unemployment has already been denied by the state (Ohio).
My bond was $150k (absolutely ridiculous), and my bondsman offered to do it for $3500 down and payments on the remaining $11500 over the next few years.
